findings.title: Production application deploys have no working manual-approval gate
findings.note: code side complete at 7dd0402: prod deploy attaches prod-approval (deploy-do.yml:648), prod migrations (supabase-migrations.yml:38), terraform apply (terraform-do.yml:204), prod load test (load-test.yml:61), prod backup/restore dispatch (db-backup.yml:48, db-restore-test.yml:45), alert-path exercise (alert-path-exercise.yml:34); docs still state no required reviewers are configured (docs/GITHUB_SECRETS_AND_VARIABLES_MATRIX.md:12-14, docs/RELEASING.md:128-133) - operator provisioning required, cannot be set from the repo.

findings.title: Branch-protection-as-code has a likely-mismatched required check and permits admin bypass
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: reproduced the guard - node scripts/check-required-checks.mjs PASS, all 8 main / 6 develop contexts resolve to emitted check-runs (incl. 'Dependency Review / review' <- dependency-review.yml job review); enforce_admins:true + require_code_owner_reviews:true in both payloads; guard + fixtures wired in the required test job (unit-tests action.yml:136-144).

findings.title: Production deploy path cannot run; prod environment lacks secrets and protection rules
findings.note: still operator-gated at 7dd0402: docs/GITHUB_SECRETS_AND_VARIABLES_MATRIX.md:187-220 (prod-approval has no required reviewers; prod secrets to be provisioned) and docs/RELEASING.md:170-182 (prod-approval lacks SUPABASE_*/JWT_SECRET/migration secrets; DO_API_TOKEN returns 401 and prod has no DROPLET_IP fallback). Cannot be provisioned from the repo.

findings.title: NEW: published fast-mode audit run fails the docs-links gate on main (required check + deploy gate red)
findings.note: reproduced at 7dd0402: node scripts/check-docs-links.mjs exits 1 - docs/audits/repo-deep-dive/mainecybertech-20261013-0126-fast-develop-905ed63 (audit_manifest.json present) is not referenced by docs/audits/README.md (last row :95 = 20261011 run) and lacks HISTORICAL.md. scripts/check-docs-links.mjs:128-153 (index coverage) and :155-177 (marker) both fail. The script runs in the required 'Test / test (20.x)' job (unit-tests action.yml:72-74) and in the deploy gate (validate.yml:88 -> validate.result must be 'success' in deploy-do.yml), so PRs and production deploys are blocked until the row + HISTORICAL.md are added. Introduced by 62a09bac (publish commit), promoted to main.

findings.title: World-open DigitalOcean firewall mutation with no approval and unvalidated udp_port
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: no firewall/wireguard workflow exists in .github/workflows (30 workflows inventoried); terraform-do rejects empty/world-open ADMIN_IP_RANGES before plan/apply (terraform-do.yml:102-113, :241-248).

findings.title: Deploy-gate secret scan is a no-op on pushes to main
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: secret-scan composite diffs against github.event.before with a zero-SHA -> HEAD~1 fallback (.github/actions/secret-scan/action.yml:15-28); used by test.yml:78-88 and validate.yml:98-108.

findings.title: Production approval environment documented as having no required reviewers
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: docs state the truth (matrix:12-14, RELEASING.md:128-133); the operational gap is tracked by CI-P1-001/003.

findings.title: DB restore test reports success without asserting restore integrity
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: db-restore-test.yml:196-330 fails on table/migration/row/freshness/RLS floors (psql counts + created_at age + rowsecurity), not just prints.

findings.title: Infrastructure changes are no longer gated in CI (terraform-do is manual-dispatch only)
findings.note: terraform-do.yml remains manual-dispatch only (header :4-8) at 7dd0402; a weekly plan-only drift run exists (:14-15) but stays dormant until the operator sets TF_DRIFT_PLAN_ENABLED=true (:40), and PR/push plan gating stays off pending DO token rotation + environment protection.

findings.title: Chromatic visual-regression job is permanently non-blocking
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: chromatic.yml has no job-level continue-on-error and exitZeroOnChanges:false (:82); a broken Storybook build fails the job. Residual: still not a required check, and the Storybook webpack pin (5.101.2, package.json overrides; commit 673d76cb) landed at this commit but docs/CI.md:149-157 + chromatic.yml comments still describe the build as broken (see CI-P3-014).

findings.title: Branch protection permits admin bypass and ignores CODEOWNERS
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: both .github/branch-protection payloads set enforce_admins:true, require_code_owner_reviews:true, allow_force_pushes:false, allow_deletions:false, required_conversation_resolution:true.

findings.title: Terraform apply is manual and drift detection is not automated
findings.note: weekly plan-only drift check wired (terraform-do.yml:14-15, fails on non-empty plan :160-172) but dormant until TF_DRIFT_PLAN_ENABLED=true (:40); apply remains manual-dispatch + approval-gated.

findings.title: E2E is a required check on main but path-filtered, so PRs that miss its paths can never satisfy branch protection
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: e2e.yml pull_request has no paths filter (:19-23); check-required-checks.mjs fails if a required check's workflow is path-filtered (fixture-tested, scripts/ci/check-required-checks.sh PASS).

findings.title: Backup dispatcher duplicates the backup workflows now that they exist on the default branch
findings.note: fixed at 7dd0402: backup-dispatch.yml no longer exists anywhere in the tree (main now contains the develop cleanup); SCHEDULE_DISPATCH_TOKEN documented retired (matrix:157-159); only backup-staleness-check.yml:50 still reads it as an optional fallback.

findings.title: actionlint/shellcheck workflow lint issues (SC2086/SC2129/SC2002/SC2015)
findings.note: shellcheck gate wired in both gates (test.yml:56, validate.yml:56; .github/actions/shellcheck/action.yml, --severity=warning) and the named issues are addressed; actionlint remains config-only (.github/actionlint.yaml) with no CI job.

findings.title: Over-broad workflow token permissions (unused write scopes)
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: no 'actions: write' grants remain anywhere in .github/; workflow-level permissions are contents:read except codeql (security-events), dependency-review (pull-requests), release (contents), sbom/deploy builds (packages/id-token/attestations).

findings.title: StrictHostKeyChecking=no in the deploy health check
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: deploy-do.yml:1128-1141 uses StrictHostKeyChecking=yes with a pinned known_hosts built from DO_SSH_HOST_KEY; alert-path-exercise.yml:111 and scripts/rollback.sh:61 the same (rollback requires an explicit last-resort opt-in for accept-new).

findings.title: `main` is far behind `develop`; scheduled jobs fire only from the default branch
findings.note: fixed at 7dd0402: origin/main contains all of origin/develop (git rev-list origin/main..origin/develop = 0; main is 7 ahead), so all 11 new scheduled workflows are on the default branch and their crons can fire. (This row was 'regressed' at 905ed63.)

findings.title: Secret scanner misses the platform's own token formats and scans diffs only
findings.note: weekly full-history gitleaks scan exists (secret-history-scan.yml); the diff scanner pattern list still lacks platform token formats dop_v1_/sbp_/glpat_/sk-proj-/npm_ (.github/actions/secret-scan/action.yml:14; scripts/scan-secrets.sh:13).

findings.title: Unused permission grants across deploy/test workflows
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: security-events:write only in codeql.yml (which uploads SARIF); terraform-do has no pull-requests:write and no dead PR-comment step; remaining grants (dependency-review pull-requests, release contents, build packages/id-token/attestations) are all consumed.

findings.title: DB restore test uses an unpinned `postgres:16-alpine` image
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: db-restore-test.yml:177 postgres:16-alpine@sha256:721873c34ceb9f8d8fc265984940dc982404c105f19ad51be9fdc5970a6080ea.

findings.title: No release/tagging workflow and no post-merge release artifact
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: release.yml cuts an annotated tag v<VERSION>-<date>-<short-sha> + GitHub Release on main pushes (:19-21, :129-145), attaches the lockfile SBOM, idempotent per commit; VERSION=0.1.0.

findings.title: e2e is required on `main` but the documented flakiness makes it an unstable hard gate
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: docs/CI.md:196-211 documents retry budget 2 + flake summary + quarantine policy; scripts/e2e-flake-summary.mjs reports retries; retried tests do not fail the job, failures after retries do.

findings.title: Missing per-job timeouts and minor workflow hygiene gaps
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: every job that can carry timeout-minutes does (30-workflow inventory, none missing); reusable-workflow callers document the callee carrying its own.

findings.title: Workflow documentation drift: docs list a removed workflow, omit a live one, and misstate gate behavior
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: replicated the docs/CI.md File-column vs .github/workflows comparison - exact match, 0 missing/0 stale; scripts/check-docs-links.mjs enforces it (note: the same script currently fails earlier on the audit-run index check - see CI-P1-004).

findings.title: Badge/report generation is a stub and is not wired into CI
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: the badge stubs are gone (no generate_badges.py/history_logger.py under scripts/); docs/CI.md:213-226 documents the real reports (coverage-reports artifact, job summaries).

findings.title: workflow_dispatch inputs are interpolated directly into run: scripts (rollback_sha/deploy_target)
findings.note: fixed at 7dd0402 (commit 07e9ce09, in main): deploy-do passes rollback_sha/deploy_target/ref through env indirection (ROLLBACK_SHA_INPUT :74-84, DEPLOY_TARGET_INPUT/REF_NAME_INPUT :88-91, ROLLBACK_SHA :482, SENTRY_RELEASE :666 env block). Remaining direct interpolations are type:choice inputs (load-test scenario :167) or env-block expressions, which GitHub validates server-side.

findings.title: NEW: Storybook webpack fix landed but CI docs/comments still describe the Chromatic build as broken
findings.note: at 7dd0402 package.json pnpm.overrides pins webpack 5.101.2 (mirrored pnpm-lock.yaml:32) and commit 673d76cb states this greens the Storybook/Chromatic build, but docs/CI.md:149-157 still says 'Known build break (TEST-P3-001) ... the red Chromatic job is the visible signal' and chromatic.yml:28-43 still says the build 'still fails'. The two states cannot both be current; re-verify the build and update the docs/comments. Underlying build fix is TEST-P3-001.
